# Ignition coil replacement without plenum removal

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove Cylinder #3 coil, contort hands under the plenum or lift it slightly to extract Coil #1. [t327]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the ignition coil on Cylinder #3 to create access space.
2. Attempt to remove Coil #1 by contorting hands under the plenum or lifting it slightly.
3. Extract the spark plug from underneath if needed for clearance.

_Procedure reported by [t327]._

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Expect a 'PITA' (pain in the ass) installation process without full disassembly. [t327]
- Consider removing the entire plenum if alignment becomes too frustrating. [t327]
